items.exampleEn: His smug comments after winning annoyed the other players.
items.exampleZh: 他贏了之後那些得意洋洋的話，惹惱了其他選手。

items.exampleEn: Our first day of skiing was exhilarating.
items.exampleZh: 我們第一天滑雪，感覺非常興奮刺激。
items.glossZh: 令人振奮的；令人興奮的

items.exampleEn: The state of the hotel room appalled us.
items.exampleZh: 飯店房間的狀況把我們嚇壞了。

items.exampleEn: The cat's antics kept the whole family laughing.
items.exampleZh: 貓咪的滑稽舉動逗得全家人笑個不停。

items.exampleEn: The students dutifully copied the notes from the board.
items.exampleZh: 學生們乖乖地把黑板上的筆記抄下來。

items.exampleEn: Sarcastic comments can hurt people more than we think.
items.exampleZh: 挖苦的話可能比我們以為的更傷人。

items.exampleEn: The tranquil music helped me fall asleep.
items.exampleZh: 寧靜的音樂幫助我入睡。

items.exampleEn: Some people see golf as a sport for elitists.
items.exampleZh: 有些人認為高爾夫是精英主義者的運動。
items.glossZh: 精英主義者；精英主義的

items.sentenceEn: Sailing in a strong wind was absolutely exhilarating.
items.sentenceZh: 在強風中駕帆船，真是太令人振奮了。

items.audioEn: The amount of food wasted at the party appalled my grandmother.
items.audioZh: 派對上浪費了那麼多食物，讓我奶奶很震驚。

items.sentenceEn: The children laughed at the clown's silly antics.
items.sentenceZh: 孩子們被小丑的滑稽動作逗得哈哈大笑。

items.sentenceEn: He dutifully visits his grandparents every Sunday.
items.sentenceZh: 他每個星期天都盡責地去探望祖父母。

items.stemEn: This small village is quiet and ____, far from any busy road.
items.stemZh: 這個小村子遠離熱鬧的馬路，安靜祥和。

items.stemEn: "Great, another meeting," he said in his usual ____ voice.
items.stemZh: 「太好了，又要開會。」他用一貫諷刺的語氣說。

items.passageEn: At my school reunion, I met an old classmate who had become a successful lawyer. He seemed rather smug about his success, and some of his comments sounded elitist; he said that people without a university degree "don't understand the world." His attitude appalled several of us. My friend Mia, who is a bit cynical, made a sarcastic joke about it, and everyone laughed. Later, we escaped to a tranquil garden behind the hall, where we remembered our teenage antics, like hiding our teacher's pens. It was an exhilarating night, full of memories.
items.passageZh: 在同學會上，我遇到一位成了成功律師的老同學。他似乎對自己的成就頗為自滿，有些話聽起來還帶著精英主義的味道：他說沒有大學學歷的人「不懂這個世界」。他的態度讓我們好幾個人很震驚。我的朋友 Mia 有點憤世嫉俗，她為此開了一個諷刺的玩笑，大家都笑了。後來，我們躲到禮堂後面一座寧靜的花園，回憶起青少年時期的胡鬧，像是把老師的筆藏起來。那是一個令人振奮、充滿回憶的夜晚。

questions.questionZh: 那位老同學的哪句話讓大家很震驚？
options: 沒大學學歷的人不懂世界
律師是全世界最辛苦的工作

referenceEn: He is often sarcastic when he talks.
He often speaks in a sarcastic way.
rubricZh: sarcastic 表示「諷刺的、挖苦的」（例如 is often sarcastic、in a sarcastic way 等）

items.instructionZh: 用 tranquil 造一個句子，描述一個讓你覺得寧靜的地方。
referenceEn: My favorite tranquil place is a small beach near my hometown.
I find the park near my office tranquil in the early morning.
rubricZh: tranquil 表示「寧靜的」，位置有彈性（例如 a tranquil place、find…tranquil 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：「安靜又寧靜」語意重複，宜作「安靜祥和」或「寧靜祥和」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 題幹改為 "This small village is quiet and ____, far from any busy road."（避開 u10-l09「清晨湖面平靜」），中譯「安靜祥和」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：單字卡 smug 與 u10-l09 "gave a wry smile" 句型重複
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "His smug comments after winning annoyed the other players."

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：自查（混合詞性題至少兩個干擾項放得進空格）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: appall 換成形容詞 ferocious（u10-l07）；exhilarating、ferocious 放得進 his usual ____ voice 但語意不通；不用 wry、placid

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：自查（同課 mcq 不可拿另一題正解當干擾項）：q13 用了 q14 正解 sarcastic
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: sarcastic 換成 vicious（u10-l02，與 quiet 矛盾）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長新規則（只看英文）修正：只看英文時 ferocious 放進句中仍說得通（in his usual ferocious voice）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: ferocious 換成 elastic（u04；elastic voice 語意不通）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長新規則（只看英文）修正：只看英文時 elitist 放進句中仍說得通（quiet and elitist village）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: elitist 換成 impervious（u04-l07；quiet and impervious 語意不通）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長 c1b2 裁示修正：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長 c1b2 裁示（第 1 批一併改）統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：sarcastic 表示「諷刺的、挖苦的」（例如 is often sarcastic、in a sarcastic way 等）／「常常」可寫，例如 often、usually 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長 c1b2 裁示修正：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長 c1b2 裁示（第 1 批一併改）統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：tranquil 表示「寧靜的」，位置有彈性（例如 a tranquil place、find…tranquil 等）
